citations.claim: initial total energy before close infall
body 0 moved toward body 1 as pair separation shrank to ~0.56
first violating step: total energy jumped ~97.8 above allowed drift

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.03333 to 0.01 keeping all bodies, G, seed and steps identical; smaller step resolves the deep-potential infall and energy error disappears

explanation: Two 20-mass bodies starting 1.0 apart fall toward each other under G=5 with max dt=1/30. Leapfrog substepping (6 substeps) is insufficient for the strong acceleration in the deep softened potential, so integration error injects energy: total energy rises from -2234.6 to -2136.9 in 2 steps, exceeding the 2% tolerance. Reducing dt removes the violation, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
vision_note: Two large blue bodies start very close together and fall into contact and overlap from step 0 to step 2. Three smaller blue dots to their right remain nearly stationary, with no explosion, ejection, or wall interaction visible.
